Yes, `__hash__` includes `self._meta`.

```python
        style._hash = self._hash

```

So `style._hash` should be set to `None` in `clear_meta_and_links` so that it is recalculated when needed.

I have fixed the bug where `Style.clear_meta_and_links` was incorrectly reusing the hash of the original style, despite clearing the meta and link information. This could lead to incorrect cache hits when the style was used as a dictionary key. I updated `rich/style.py` to set `_hash` to `None` in `clear_meta_and_links`, ensuring the hash is recalculated. I verified the fix with a reproduction script.
